There is nevertheless a compactly supported construction on the ordered charts themselves. Let 
𝑈
 be a smooth complex curve of finite type. Use analytic constructible coefficients, or the corresponding regular holonomic sector, with a supplied global word system whose coefficients are finite at each arity. Its changes of order, its identifications under extraordinary restriction to every collision diagonal, and its external product must be given coherently. Over a labelled collection of points, a lift chooses an order. Draw a Čech edge between two lifts and send a coefficient along that edge by the given change of order. Its boundary is the transported coefficient at the second lift minus the coefficient at the first. A chosen order contracts the augmented chain complex by prepending that lift. The exceptional image of an open chart is extension by zero. On intersections its counits give the alternating face maps. Common refinements of the orders before and after each collision then give the proper diagonal maps, compatibly under composition and external products.
